shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo "-----" && find .agents -type f && echo "-----" && ls -la && cat AGENTS.md | head -100

cat package.json && echo ----- && cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html .gitignore && echo ----- && find src -type f | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "== {}"; cat {}' && echo ----- && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && for p in node_modules/@gravity-ui/*; do echo "$p $(node -p "require('./$p/package.json').version")"; done

cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -150 && echo ----- && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && echo ----- && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Card Switch ThemeProvider Flex Text Header Tabs Link 2>&1 | head -80

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Switch ThemeProvider Text 2>&1 | head -60; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; echo ----; node -p "Object.keys(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').dependencies||{}).join(' ')"; echo; npm view @gravity-ui/navigation version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -30
npm view @gravity-ui/navigation versions --json 2>/dev/null | tail -40; for v in 3.0.0 2.0.0; do :; done; npm view @gravity-ui/navigation@'^7' version peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null | tail -60

npm install @gravity-ui/navigation@7.1.3 @gravity-ui/icons@^2.23.1 @bem-react/classname@^1.6.0 2>&1 | tail -15; node -p "['@gravity-ui/navigation','@gravity-ui/uikit','@gravity-ui/icons','@bem-react/classname'].map(p=>p+' '+require('./node_modules/'+p+'/package.json').version).join('\n')"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json | grep -A8 '"exports"' | head -30

git diff --stat; cat package.json | head -25; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -150; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/hooks

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components && wc -l AsideHeader.md && rg -n "^#|menuItems|onItemClick|current|renderContent|compact|onChangeCompact|logo|rightContent|Footer|MenuItem|renderItem|items" AsideHeader.md | head -120

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build && rg -n "AsideHeaderItem\b" docs/components/AsideHeader.md | head -5; rg -n "^### .AsideHeaderItem" -A 20 docs/components/AsideHeader.md | cut -c1-260 | head -40; echo ----; ls; f=$(rg -l "export type AsideHeaderItem|interface AsideHeaderItem" --glob '*.d.ts' . | head -3); echo "$f"

rg -n "AsideHeaderItem" -A 30 esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head -80; echo ----; rg -n "export" esm/index.d.ts | head -30; echo ----; rg -n "onItemClick|interface .*Props|hideCollapseButton|export type AsideHeaderProps" esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head -20

rg -n "export (interface|type) AsideHeaderItem" -A 40 esm/components/AsideHeader/ | head -60; rg -n "theme|Theme" esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head; echo ----; rg -n "interface LogoProps" -A 15 esm/components/Logo/*.d.ts | head -30
rg -n "export interface MenuItem\b" -A 25 --glob '*.d.ts' esm | cut -c1-220 | head -40; rg -n "export interface LogoProps" -A 14 --glob '*.d.ts' esm | cut -c1-220 | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules && rg -n "useThemeType|export declare const ThemeProvider|theme\?:|scoped" @gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/*.d.ts @gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/*/ThemeProvider*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; rg -l "useThemeType" @gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --glob '*.d.ts' | head -3; echo ----; for n in House Sun Moon Gear Persons Circle Star Rocket Bell Folder Clock Xmark Lightbulb Sliders; do test -f @gravity-ui/icons/esm/$n.js 2>/dev/null && echo "OK $n" || echo "-- $n"; done; ls @gravity-ui/icons | head;

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && cat components/theme/types.d.ts | head -30; cat components/theme/useThemeType.d.ts; rg -n "onUpdate|checked|size" components/controls/Switch/Switch.d.ts | head; rg -n "export declare const Text|variant" components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -5; rg -n "export" components/index.d.ts | head -3

f=$(rg -l "onUpdate" components --glob 'Switch*.d.ts' | head -2); echo "$f"; for x in $f; do rg -n "onUpdate|checked|content|size" $x | head -8; done; rg -n "view" components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -3; rg -n "export" components/Card/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -2

ls components/controls | head -40; rg -n "Switch" components/index.d.ts components/controls/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; find . -iname "*switch*.d.ts" | head; find . -name "Button*.d.ts" | head -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Switch/Switch.d.ts | head -40; rg -n "ButtonView\b" -A3 Button/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "export type ButtonView" Button/ | head -2

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules && rg -n "export (declare )?(interface|type|const|function) (FooterItem|FooterItemProps)" -A 12 --glob '*.d.ts' @gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm | cut -c1-200 | head -40; echo ----; cd @gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && rg -n "export interface ControlProps" -A 12 --glob '*.d.ts' . | cut -c1-200 | head -20; echo ----; rg -n "onUpdate|value|placeholder|size" components/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts components/controls/TextInput/*.d.ts --glob '*.d.ts' 2>/dev/null | head -10; rg -ln "export declare const Checkbox" --glob '*.d.ts' . ; rg -ln "export declare const Card\b" --glob '*.d.ts' .

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build && rg -n "FooterItem" esm/components/AsideHeader/index.d.ts esm/components/AsideHeader/components/index.d.ts esm/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; cat esm/components/index.d.ts | head -20; echo ----; sed -n 86,104p docs/components/AsideHeader.md | cut -c1-200; echo ----; rg -n "export declare const Card|interface CardProps|type CardView|view\?" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && sed -n 1,27p Card/Card.d.ts; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -rn "Checkbox\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons && for n in House Check CircleInfo Moon Sun Xmark; do test -f $n.d.ts && echo "OK $n" || echo "MISSING $n"; done; cd ../uikit/build/esm && rg -n "lang\?|lang:" components/theme/types.d.ts components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts | head -3; rg -n "width\?|wrap" components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; rg -n "content\?" components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head -2
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -40; echo "TSC EXIT: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -15
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput && sed -n 1,80p TextInput.d.ts | grep -n "?:" | cut -c1-160
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -12; echo "BUILD EXIT: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
rm -rf dist && git status --short && git diff --stat -- package.json && find src -type f | sort
